title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E3 — Show Biz
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E4 — Virus
A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E5 — Peace Pipe
The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E6 — Saddled
The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E10 — Water, Water Everywhere
A greedy developer attempts to stop disabled veterans (Jim Knaub, Jon L. Feather, R. David Smith) from renovating a desert town.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E11 — Steel
A struggling contractor's (Norman Alden) warehouse-demolition site is sabotaged by a mob-hired competitor.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E12 — The White Ballot
Face becomes a candidate for sheriff to expose a small-town law officer's shady dealings. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E13 — The Maltese Cow
The team foils both an international dope deal and extortionists preying on a Chinese restaurateur (Keye Luke).

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E14 — In Plane Sight
The team must flush a major cocaine trafficker out of Colombia to help a young woman clear her uncle of drug-smuggling.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E15 — The Battle of Bel Air
Reporter Tawnia Baker poses as a computer operator to help the team capture terrorists plotting to assassinate a sheik.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E16 — Say It With Bullets
A woman hires the team to investigate the murder of her brother, who was part of a munitions theft operation.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E17 — Pure-Dee Poison
The team helps a Southern minister (John Amos) break a ring selling poisonous moonshine; guests Bo Hopkins, Tracy Reed.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E18 — It's a Desert Out There
The team fights robbers, led by a bandit (Jeannie Wilson), who ambush tour buses leaving a run-down Nevada casino.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S4 E14 — The Harder They Fall
David 'Blackwell' is paralyzed; He becomes convinced the Hulk's powers could make him walk again.
